documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 818.7 crores, representing a 54.8% YoY growth, with sales volumes up 10% YoY to 577 kgs. Revenue for H1 FY27 reached INR 1,367.2 crores with sales volumes of 968 kgs. The company has expanded its manufacturing capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes and entered the bridal jewellery segment, which currently accounts for approximately 10% of total manufacturing volume. Additionally, Shringar House approved the setup of a wholly-owned subsidiary to target lightweight, affordable, and digital B2C/B2B jewellery segments. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited published its Investor Presentation for Q2 & H1 FY27.

guidance.claim: Shringar House aims to scale its corporate client business share from 51% to 65%.
guidance.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

guidance.claim: The bridal jewellery business could potentially reach a size comparable to the core business within two to two-and-a-half years.
guidance.quote: This share s expected to continue growing; in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

guidance.claim: The company expects production to ramp up in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: The company expects retail expansion plans of its corporate clients to drive additional demand for its products.
guidance.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

demand_outlook.claim: End-market demand remains encouraging due to the ongoing festive and wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the industry, the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for lightweight jewellery, contemporary designs, and affordable products continues to create growth opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's mangalsutra category is growing at a CAGR of 30%.
demand_outlook.quote: Furthermore, our mangalsutra category is performing exceptionally well, growing at a CAGR of 30%.

demand_outlook.claim: The company uses outsourced production alongside in-house capacity to meet growing product demand.
demand_outlook.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

demand_outlook.claim: The retail expansion plans of corporate clients are expected to drive additional product demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

capex_expansion.claim: Shringar House is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand across the broader jewellery value chain.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term expansion strategy, we are in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand our presence across the broader jewellery value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed subsidiary will be funded initially with minimal capital of up to INR 2 to 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We can, but for this, we have thought that first we open a subsidiary with a very minimal fund, like INR2 crores, INR4 crores, INRS crores at most, since it is a new venture.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to expand its manufacturing capacity further to support the bridal segment.
capex_expansion.quote: To further strengthen this position, we intend to expand our manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Approximately ₹15 crore was invested via internal accruals to expand capacity and upgrade machinery.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established branch offices in Delhi and Pune to build a pan-India supply chain model.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q2 FY27 reached INR 54.9 crores with an EBITDA margin of 6.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR54.9 crores, a 68.7% growth Y-0-Y, while EBITDA margin stood at 6.7%, a growth of 50 bps.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 39.5 crores with a PAT margin of 4.8%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR39.5 crores, up by 73.2% Y-o-Y. PAT margin at 4.8%.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs increased as the company expanded capacity and hired more designers and karigars for the bridal segment.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

margins_costs.claim: An increase in gold prices improves company profitability due to percentage-based charging models.
margins_costs.quote: If gold prices increase, our profitability actually improves. The reason is that we charge on a percentage basis.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 revenue from operations increased by 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from ₹861.41 crore in H1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT increased 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore in H1 FY27, recording a PAT margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume in Q2 FY27 grew 10% YoY to 577 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the quarter stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% Y-0-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing capacity has been increased from 2.5 tonnes to 4 tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

orders_capacity.claim: Bridal jewellery currently accounts for approximately 10% of total manufacturing volume.
orders_capacity.quote: So, within our entire manufacturing operations, the bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10%.

orders_capacity.claim: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed on February 23, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: New capacity was added in February 2026, resulting in a full-year blended capacity of 2,625 kg and 87% actual capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow management is the top priority for company management.
capital_allocation.quote: Limited cash flow management is our top priority today.

capital_allocation.claim: Shringar House maintains a minimum hedged inventory position in the range of 30% to 35%.
capital_allocation.quote: Thus, we maintain a hedge in the range of 30% to 35%.

capital_allocation.claim: Net operating cash outflow improved to -₹77.91 crore in H1 FY27 compared to -₹412.11 crore in H1 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

capital_allocation.claim: Gold metal loan facilities were secured from two private banks to support production cycles.
capital_allocation.quote: Secured gold loan facilities from two private banks, leveraging our deposits to earn a positive yield from one of these banks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility and uncertainty have made consumers more cautious regarding spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company highlights risks including competition, technological shifts, and economic performance across domestic and global markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and worldwide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business operations are working capital intensive and demand liquidity to support expansion across locations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our operations are working capital intensive, requiring adequate liquidity and funds to support business expansion and diversification across multiple locations

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase its business share with corporate chain clients from 51% to 65%.
management_commitments.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

management_commitments.claim: The bridal jewellery segment is expected to reach a size comparable to the core business within two to two-and-a-half years.
management_commitments.quote: This share s expected to continue growing; in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the current capacity is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
